potato_s_t.guide.category.getting_starte: The first machine, the first production line, and the rules every machine shares.
potato_s_t.guide.category.materials.desc: How ore becomes dust, ingots and plates, plus the blast furnace, alloys and titanium.
potato_s_t.guide.category.power.desc: Wiring, generation, storage, and how fluids and gases are moved.
potato_s_t.guide.category.oil.desc: Where crude oil comes from, how to lay out the distillation tower, and the four chemical machines.
potato_s_t.guide.category.starfall.desc: Stargazing, calling down meteors, and arming yourself with Star Steel and Vibranium.
potato_s_t.guide.category.faq.desc: A machine that will not run, or fluids that will not match. Read these two pages first.
potato_s_t.guide.landing: This book tracks the mod version. Every step points to a recipe listed in JEI. Pick a chapter on the left and start with Getting Started.$(br2)If you lose the book, craft another from one vanilla book and one iron ingot.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.getting_started.s: The main line has five steps: grind raw ore into dust, smelt dust into ingots in the Electric Blast Furnace, press ingots into plates, expand into power and chemistry, and finish with the meteor.$(br2)Nothing is made without dust, so the first build is a Micro Crusher. It needs a steady power supply, and a Low-Tier Generator burning coal or charcoal covers that at the start.

Place the crusher in the middle of your work area and leave one block of clearance in front of it. Then run power to it: build a Low-Tier Generator and carry the power over with terminal blocks or cable. See the Power chapter.$(br2)Dust is the foundation of everything later. Grind every raw ore you find and do not worry about the amount.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.getting_started.f: A complete starter line has four steps: raw ore into the Micro Crusher becomes dust, dust into the Electric Blast Furnace becomes an ingot, and an ingot into the Hydraulic Press becomes a plate.$(br2)Plates are a common part of nearly every machine, so press a batch whenever you run low. Ingots can also be crafted directly, so not every ingot has to become a plate. Bitumen is pressed 12 at a time.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.getting_started.r: Every machine follows one hard rule: a redstone signal stops it and the progress is kept. For an on/off switch, place a lever or redstone line next to the machine.$(br2)A machine accepts its own ingredients only. If you insert the wrong item, the interface states what it refuses.

Sneak-right-click any machine with an empty hand for a slot-by-slot diagnosis. It reports which slot lacks what, which tank is empty, and whether power is missing.$(br2)The energy bar, fluid tanks, progress bar and status lamp on the interface are all live. When the status lamp turns red, read the diagnosis first and act on what it names.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.materials.ore_cha: There are 9 ores: aluminum, cobalt, nickel, silver, uranium, manganese, lithium, tungsten and titanium. 7 of them have a deepslate variant.$(br2)The standard process has three steps: raw ore into the Micro Crusher becomes dust, and dust into the Electric Blast Furnace becomes an ingot. Sand, raw aluminum and raw silver can also be smelted in a vanilla furnace, but dust in the blast furnace yields more.

Press ingots into plates with the Hydraulic Press: iron, copper, nickel, cobalt, silver, aluminum and steel plates. Plates are a common part of nearly every machine, so press a batch of whatever you lack.$(br2)A redstone signal stops the press and the progress is kept.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.materials.blast_a: The Electric Blast Furnace is a 3x3x3 multiblock, assembled directly on a vanilla blast furnace. It has 12 input slots and 32 output slots. Each slot finishes in 10 seconds and every item costs 800 FE.$(br2)Besides this mod's ore processing, anything a vanilla blast furnace can smelt works here. Dust in the blast furnace yields more than in a vanilla furnace.

The Alloy Smelter Controller must be laid out in 4 layers, 58 cells in total: the floor, the three-high walls, and those two rows of heat-resistant metal on the roof. The shell also needs at least 1 wiring block before it activates on its own.$(br2)The interface has 5 input slots that accept ingots only, 3 output slots and 2 consumption slots. Storage is 32768 FE and power enters through the port only.

The titanium line: grind raw titanium into titanium dust, then smelt the dust into a titanium ingot in the Electric Blast Furnace.$(br2)Titanium then goes into alloys: light titanium alloy, hard titanium alloy and the stable metal block. The Acidic Reaction Chamber and the Lithium Battery both need them. The titanium alloy sword and pickaxe are also made from light titanium alloy.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.materials.salt.p1: The Salt Dryer only works in an ocean or salty river biome, between Y 0 and 64, with a water source block below it. Passive drying yields 1 sea salt every 120 seconds.$(br2)Supply power and it yields 1 every 20 seconds.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.materials.salt.p2: Note: sea salt that falls into water dissolves and is lost.$(br2)The Salt Decomposer takes 64 sea salt and yields 1 sodium chloride after 40 seconds. It returns those 64 sea salt with a 60% chance, and adds one random raw ore with a separate 5% chance. Place sea salt in the Electrolyzer's electrolyte slot to produce extra chlorine while electrolysing water, at the cost of 1 extra sea salt per 500 mB of water.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.power.wiring.p1: Terminal blocks carry power over distance. Right-click to place the first terminal and select it, then right-click a second terminal to link the two. If the distance is too great it refuses and states the limit.$(br2)The wiring block on a machine shell is the power inlet and outlet; that cell becomes a port once the multiblock forms. Connect terminals to those.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.power.wiring.p2: Cable spools also link terminals. Copper and silver spools both reach 16 blocks and both have 32 durability, and both return an empty spool when spent. The difference is the rate: copper carries 2048 FE/t and silver 16134 FE/t.$(br2)A power cable spool carries power rather than FE. The Power Capturer uses it to draw power in.
The Low-Tier Generator burns coal or charcoal for power, and a redstone signal stops it. It is the simplest power source at the start, and one unit is enough to run a Micro Crusher.

The Solar Panel generates power in daylight only and is strongest near noon. The block directly above it must be air or colorless glass. Horizontally adjacent panels link up on their own and share generation and storage across the group.$(br2)Output is 60% in rain, 20% in a thunderstorm, and zero at night.

For larger amounts of power, use the power line. The Power Capturer draws power while it sits next to a power source and delivers it over power cables. A generator then converts that power into FE at 2 FE/t per point.$(br2)These three machines together are what starts the industrial stage.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.power.storage.p1: One ternary polymer lithium battery stores 4M FE. Batteries placed edge to edge in a solid cuboid merge into a single multiblock on their own, and the capacity adds up per block. The top face is the only face that transfers FE.$(br2)The base accepts 6 footprints only: 2x2, 2x3, 3x3, 3x4, 4x4 and 5x5. 2x2 reaches 6 layers, 2x3, 3x3 and 3x4 reach 12 layers, and 4x4 and 5x5 reach 32 layers.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.power.storage.p2: A battery needs components first. The Lithium Battery Plant takes four inputs: raw manganese or raw aluminum, a nickel ingot or raw nickel, lithium carbonate, and a cobalt ingot or raw cobalt. Feed in sulfuric acid and it yields one lithium battery component every 30 seconds.$(br2)This machine uses no power, because it runs on chemistry. Lithium carbonate comes from grinding raw lithium into lithium concentrate and smelting that in the Electric Blast Furnace.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.power.fluids.p1: Liquids travel in oil buckets and gases in high pressure tanks. Both are filled by the Filling Machine. The Filling Machine holds five 5000 mB tanks, and one tank holds one fluid only. Right-click the machine with an oil bucket or a gas tank in hand to pour its contents into a tank.$(br2)Filling runs at 5 mB/t per tank, and each working tank draws 60 FE/t.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.power.fluids.p2: To put fluid from a machine back into a bucket, use the Fluid Exchanger: an oil bucket or gas tank holding fluid in the left slot, one empty bucket in the right slot, and it turns the empty bucket into a bucket of that fluid.$(br2)Fluids with no bucket form, namely crude oil, naphtha and LPG, are refused outright. A pump is the only way to move those.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.power.fluids.p3: The Fluid Pump: the front face is the input and the back face is the output, and pipes attach to those two faces only. Right-click for the rate control, which spans 0% to 800%. The pump stores no fluid itself and moves only what the destination accepts.$(br2)Gases must go through a Fluid Pump. The Fluid Exchanger does not handle gas tanks.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.oil.crude.p1: Oil fields occur on land and under the ocean. Right-click the block of an oil field with an empty oil bucket to scoop one bucket of crude oil. An empty bucket alone does not work.$(br2)Volume requires the Oil Extractor. It runs in the Ocean Oilfield biome only, and stops anywhere else.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.oil.crude.p2: The Oil Extractor hangs a chain downward from directly below the machine, and that chain must be waterlogged. The number of waterlogged chain blocks is n. It draws 8n² plus 80n FE/t and produces 10n mB/s, and it carries a 25-bucket tank.$(br2)Every 25 to 80 buckets pumped, the ocean oilfield in a 10x10 chunk area centred on the machine turns into the ordinary ocean nearby. Those 100 chunks include the machine itself, so move the machine to a remaining oilfield afterwards.
The Distillation Tower Controller recognises a tower of 4x4x7, 7 layers in total. Layers 1 and 2 carry common metal blocks in the four corners. In layers 3 and 5 the corners are common metal blocks, the edges are heat-resistant metal blocks, and the central 2x2 is heaters. Layers 4 and 6 are a ring of heat-resistant metal blocks. Layer 7 is common metal blocks across the whole 4x4.$(br2)Cells drawn hollow on the blueprint take no block.

The Distillation Operator is the machine that does the work. Each tower holds 12 buckets of crude oil and 2.5 buckets of each product, and a redstone signal starts it.$(br2)One tower splits crude oil into five parts: diesel, gasoline, naphtha, LPG and bitumen. More towers mean more throughput and more tank capacity.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.oil.chemistry.p1: Combustion Chamber: the fuel slot accepts what a vanilla furnace burns, which is a lava bucket for 10 seconds, a diesel or gasoline bucket for 30 seconds, and anything else for 3 seconds. One unit of fuel plus 10 mB of oxygen starts the reaction. While it runs, it feeds 800 power per tick to the Power Capturer, or 1200 for diesel and 1000 for gasoline.$(br2)Place it next to the Capturer.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.oil.chemistry.p2: The Air Separator draws 200 FE per tick and yields nitrogen and oxygen. The raw material is air, which never runs out.$(br2)The Ammonia Synthesis Chamber needs three things: nitrogen and hydrogen in the input tanks, plus one iron dust as a catalyst that is not consumed. The ammonia it yields is the raw material for nitric acid.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.oil.chemistry.p3: The Hydrodesulfurization Chamber takes 16 bitumen plus 1000 mB of hydrogen per batch and yields sulfur, which is the raw material for sulfuric acid. This machine uses no power, because it runs on chemistry.$(br2)The Acidic Reaction Chamber draws 500 FE per tick, and its four recipes are listed in JEI: carbonic acid, nitric acid, sulfuric acid and hydrochloric acid.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.oil.diesel_gen.p1: The Large Diesel Generator is a 3x5x2 multiblock of 30 cells. With the controller's facing as the front, it extends 5 rows back and 2 layers up, and not one cell may be missing.$(br2)The copper blocks and grates inside accept any oxidation level, waxed or not, so all 16 variants count. Once complete, the wiring block directly above the controller becomes a port, and power leaves through that port only.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.oil.diesel_gen.p2: The interface holds one 8000 mB diesel tank and one status lamp. It burns 1 mB of diesel per tick and generates 7200 FE. A redstone signal stops it.$(br2)Diesel enters by pump, or right-click the controller with a diesel bucket. The fluid pump, the two low-tier generators and the combustion chamber inside remain themselves after forming.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.starfall.sky_and_: Right-click the Star Chart Tome to cycle the Overworld skybox forward, and sneak-right-click to cycle it back. Four star charts plus the vanilla sky form the loop.$(br2)The setting is stored in the tome's own components and is visible to you alone. Other players on the server still see the vanilla sky.

Right-click the Starfall Pendant to throw it. The meteor falls from y = 200 after 30 seconds. The first 10 seconds allow a second right-click to cancel it, after which it locks and the whole server sees the countdown and the coordinates.$(br2)Impact is an explosion of power 7 to 20 and sprays a batch of raw ore. Power 7 to 12 yields raw iron and raw copper only, 13 and above yields every raw ore, and 15 and above adds 3 raw vibranium.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.starfall.star_ste: The Star Steel set is in tune with the night. When darkness falls every piece grants Resistance I and the gear does not wear. All four in resonance never wear in the End.$(br2)It also finds a block to stand on within 20x20, catches you first and then erases the fall. If nothing stands there, it trades your place with a creature nearby.

Shift plus right-click with the Star Steel Sword spends 100 durability and cuts an 8-block starlight slash that pierces every enemy along its path for 12 damage each and lights them for 5 seconds. The Star Steel Axe works the same way and releases a 6-block-wide shockwave that fells logs only.$(br2)The Vibranium set is the other route: unbreakable throughout, immune to projectiles and fall damage, with Resistance I at all times.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.faq.machine.p1: Check in this order. First, whether a redstone signal is present, because that stops the machine. Second, whether the multiblock shell carries a wiring block, because no power means no work. Third, a structure gap: right-click the controller and it prints the coordinates of the missing cell to chat. Fourth, sneak-right-click with an empty hand for the slot-by-slot diagnosis, which names what is missing.$(br2)A full tank, a blocked output slot or a missing catalyst also stops a machine.
potato_s_t.guide.entry.faq.fluid.p1: It is almost always one of three things. A tank holds one fluid only, so a tank that held something else must be emptied first. Crude oil, naphtha and LPG have no bucket form, so the Fluid Exchanger refuses them and only a pump can move them. Gases must go through high pressure tanks and pumps.$(br2)One more: a machine's fluid tanks are usually output-only or input-only, so read the tooltip before attaching pipes.
potato_s_t.configuration.black_hole.life: How many seconds a black hole exists (5-120, default 20). A longer life pulls more blocks and costs more performance.
potato_s_t.configuration.black_hole.max_: How many blocks one black hole may move (100-5000, default 1500).
potato_s_t.configuration.black_hole.scan: Each axis spans +/- N blocks around the hole (8-80, default 40 = 5x5x5 chunks). Each added block grows the scanned volume cubically. Raise it only after checking your TPS.
potato_s_t.configuration.black_hole.pull: Whether creatures, players included, are pulled toward the singularity. Default on. Off means blocks only.
potato_s_t.configuration.black_hole.void: Whether creatures inside the event horizon, 6 blocks, take continuous void damage. Default on. Off means it pulls creatures only and deals no damage.
potato_s_t.configuration.black_hole.one_: On: the gravity device places one black hole only. Off: it consumes power only and can be reused.
How long right-click is held before the black hole is released (5-60, default 30 seconds).
How much energy the gravity device holds (1,000,000-64,000,000, default 8,000,000).
potato_s_t.configuration.lithium_battery: How much energy one lithium battery stores (1,000,000-20,000,000, default 4,000,000); the multiblock total is the block count times this value.
How much energy may enter or leave each face per tick (1,024-1,048,576, default 65,536).
How many blocks one battery may combine (27-800, default 800).
